description: NGC 1275's starlight as a volume: the survey image with the Milky Way stars removed (NOX) and neighbouring galaxies masked, its light along each sight line spread in depth by the deprojected density of Sahu, Graham & Davis's published Sérsic fit, on an oblate spheroid about NGC 1275's minor axis in the plane of the sky. Depth follows that stated shape; it is not measured.
